observations: Every invalid scan is ext4/medusa, with application rc=1 and stderr readdir64: No such file or directory.
All 18 raw getdents64 streams reached terminal zero. The application did not emit END eof.
All 18 invalid streams ended on a configured hidden target; all 42 valid ext4 attack streams ended on an ordinary entry.
Existing invalid-stream S/L bytes also decoded exactly in offline replay, but are excluded from primary accuracy because the application gate failed and a complete K record was not saved.
source_supported_interpretation: The pinned readdir64 wrapper returns immediately on EOF; it clears errno only when returning a visible entry. Its filtering loop invokes hidden_stat on basenames. An error left by filtering can therefore reach the caller if the final entries are hidden. This explains the observed EOF/ENOENT pattern; the precise errno-setting syscall was not separately traced.

controlled_application.behaviour: Clears errno before readdir64; NULL with nonzero errno is an application error.
